en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a landscaped park with paths, benches, trees and flower beds leading toward a large multi‑storey building in the background. On the reverse, it is formatted as a divided back postcard with printed multilingual heading and a green postage stamp. Handwritten text and address are visible, along with a museum/archive stamp label. At the bottom left of the message side appears a caption naming the spa town and park.
